```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
getwd()
list.files("../../../2019_HTS_course/wetlab/protocols/")

sample_layout.file = "../../../2019_HTS_course/wetlab/protocols/sample_and_library_info.xlsx"
excel_sheets(sample_layout.file)
```

```{r}
read_excel(sample_layout.file, sheet="2019_lab_plate", skip=6) %>%
  select(-X__1) %>%
  rename(i5index = X__2) ->
  plate_layout.df

plate_layout.df
```

```{r}
gather(plate_layout.df, key="i7index", "sample", -i5index) %>%
  arrange(i5index, i7index) ->
  sample_indices.df
sample_indices.df
```
